description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface named AstrologyDao for accessing astrology-related data from a database, using Room persistence library annotations such as @Dao, @Query, @Insert, @Update, and @Delete. It specifies functions for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting astrology details based on date, modification time, or id.

classes.name: AstrologyDao
classes.description: An interface annotated with @Dao that provides methods to interact with the astrology_details table in the database.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves a list of astrology details modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertAstrology
methods.description: Inserts or replaces astrology details into the database.

methods.name: deleteAstrologyById
methods.description: Deletes astrology details by their unique identifier.
